text:
Maria (PM): quick sync — we need to lock down prioritization and launch gates for the Optimize Toolkit feature set (batching, prefix cache, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts). customers are asking for a clear pilot commitment.
Jon (Eng): ack. can we list must-haves vs nice-to-haves for alpha?
Maria (PM): must-haves: per-route batching heuristics, basic KV prefix caching, a single quantization recommendation flow (FP16/INT8 guidance), and an eval-triggered alert that fires on clear regressions. nice-to-have: auto-applied quant profiles, per-tenant tuning UI.
Lee (ML): for the eval alerts we need an eval harness and signal definitions. propose: alert on >3% degradation in our primary quality metric (concordance/accuracy) across a weighted prompt set, or a 10% jump in perplexity.
Priya (CS): customers pushed for a safety net — a way to opt-out of automatic recommendations and a manual approval step before apply.
Sam (Solutions): +1 to manual approval. many enterprise customers require change logs and an audit step.
Jon (Eng): operational SLOs thoughts: keep p95 latency within 1.2x baseline and ensure CPU/GPU memory overhead doesn't blow out. Cost target for pilot: 20–30% token cost reduction on targeted workloads.
Anish (SRE): we'll need rollout controls and feature flags. also need metrics exposure: per-route cost-savings, token-per-second throughput, cache hit-rate.
Maria (PM): proposed launch gates for alpha pilot: 1) stable eval harness in CI; 2) integration test with 3 reference workloads; 3) telemetry dashboard (cache hit-rate, p95 latency, cost delta); 4) documented opt-out and audit log.
Jon (Eng): blockers: (a) quant recommendation engine still experimental for some model families, (b) continuous prefix cache needs eviction policy decided, (c) batching heuristics vary a lot for mobile vs server clients.
Lee (ML): for (a) we can ship conservative recommendations (e.g., FP16 for Llama variants, INT8 for vetted checkpoints) and mark others as experimental. need a compatibility matrix.
Maria (PM): acceptance criteria (alpha): - baseline functional tests pass across 3 pilot customers - median cost per token drops >=18% for pilot workloads - p95 latency <= 1.2x baseline for 95% of routes - eval-triggered alerts working in staging and firing on injected regressions
Priya (CS): pilot customers: AcmeDocs (document summarization), Conversa (chat product), DataHive (search embeddings). all signed up for limited rollouts.
Sam (Solutions): rollouts plan suggestion: staged canary: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% per route, with automatic rollback on any of: eval regression >3%, p95 >1.2x, cache mem usage > threshold.
Maria (PM): canary limits config example: 
```
rollout_policy:
  stage_1: 1%
  stage_2: 10%
  stage_3: 50%
  fail_conditions:
    - eval_regression_pct: 3
    - p95_latency_factor: 1.2
```
Jon (Eng): impl notes: need to expose a per-model quant profile and a fallback to unquantized path. also ensure KV caching is keyed by prompt fingerprint to avoid cross-tenant leaks.
Anish (SRE): security ask: audit log entries for every auto-recommendation and apply action. KMS integration is required for Private customers.
Lee (ML): eval-triggered alert mechanics: run nightly eval on production-sampled traffic. if metric delta crosses threshold for 3 consecutive runs -> open P1 alert to product + eng + cs.
Priya (CS): also require a customer-facing changelog email template and support playbook for false positives.
Maria (PM): prioritization vote: which 2 items must be in alpha? 1) per-route batching + heuristics 2) eval-triggered alerts 3) basic KV prefix caching 4) quant recommendations engine (conservative)
Jon (Eng): vote: 1,3
Lee (ML): vote: 2,4
Priya (CS): vote: 2,1
Sam (Solutions): vote: 1,2
Maria (PM): tally seems to favor: 1) batching + heuristics, 2) eval-triggered alerts. we keep caching and quant recommendations in the alpha scope but marked as "beta features" with conservative defaults and opt-in.
Jon (Eng): timeline ask: can we target internal alpha in 6 weeks and limited customer pilot in 10 weeks?
Maria (PM): tentative plan: 6w internal, 10w pilot. dependencies: eval harness (Lee), rollout flag infra (Anish), telemetry dashboards (Jon + EngOps).
Anish (SRE): will create feature-flag tickets and alert hooks. need eng to define metrics endpoint schema.
Jon (Eng): I'll draft the metric names and schema: `optimize.batch.hit_rate`, `optimize.cache.hit_rate`, `optimize.cost.delta_pct`, `optimize.eval.regression_pct`, `optimize.p95_latency_factor`.
Maria (PM): AOB: customer legal asked about data residency for cache keys. answer: keys must not include PII; we need a short guidance doc. Priya to draft.
Priya (CS): on it. will draft opt-out + changelog templates and the short residency guidance.
Sam (Solutions): can we add one pager for sales that quantifies expected savings with sample workloads? I'll draft after engineering supplies sample numbers.
Maria (PM): ACTIONS: Jon: metric schema + telemetry tickets (due 5 business). Lee: eval harness plan + regression test set (due 7 business). Anish: feature-flag infra + alert hooks (due 7 business). Priya: customer docs/templates (due 5 business). Sam: sales one-pager draft (due 10 business).
ops-bot: Ticket created: OPT-5421 (metric-schema), OPT-5422 (eval-harness), OPT-5423 (feature-flags), OPT-5424 (customer-docs)
Maria (PM): thanks all — we'll reconvene next week to review progress and firm up pilot invites. :thumbsup:
Jon (Eng): thanks!
Lee (ML): thanks, will post the eval mockups in #eng-ml.
Priya (CS): ping me if you need customer comms language.
Sam (Solutions): will sync with sales on expected ROI figures.
Anish (SRE): noted. starting infra tickets.
